Retroactive public goods funding (RPGF) is one application of the decentralized curation framework. This repository develops two distinct proposed funding lifecycles: an ongoing public-goods companion paper and a fixed-round reference proposal. Both apply the foundational paper's accuracy and relevance distinction to challengeable nominations and funding weights.

- [Read the ongoing public-goods companion](./companion/)
